data.value: Play opens a terminal for game commands. When a scene is available, Story view offers a structured view of that scene on the same connection. Check your current character and connection status. Look for the room description, who is here, and the exits. An exit moves your character; reading a description does not.

data.name: GuideLesson_Discord_useful-action_Body
data.value: The look command asks the game to describe where you are. Try it in local practice first. Then insert look into the empty, connected Game command box (or Command mode in Story) and press Send yourself. Inserting it does not send or complete this step.

data.name: GuideLesson_Discord_speak-act_Body
data.value: In the terminal, say Hello speaks to people in your room and pose waves. describes your character waving. Story view, when a scene is available, also offers Say, OOC and Emit modes that treat your text literally; Command runs game syntax and expressions. A page targets one named player. What your character says and does is in character (IC); talk about the game or the real world is out of character (OOC), so mark it the way this game asks, such as Story's OOC mode. Practice here is local; check the game's etiquette before speaking live.

data.name: GuideLesson_Discord_continue_Body

data.name: GuideLesson_Discord_place_Body

data.name: GuideLesson_Mush_place_Body
